sobre.label: About me
sobre.headline: Over 5 years building software that moves from plan to real users.
sobre.about: I am Henrique Garcia, a full-stack developer focused on front-end, performance, and user experience. Since 2018, I have been building and improving e-commerce platforms, management systems, SaaS products, dashboards, apps, and digital products. I like to understand the problem deeply, organize the technical path, and deliver clear interfaces connected to solid architecture.

feedback1.message: Henrique turned a loose idea into a clear, organized system ready for use. Communication was direct, and every delivery came with context about what had evolved.

feedback2.message: The project needed speed without losing quality. The delivery brought a professional interface, strong performance, and a technical base that is easy to keep evolving.

feedback3.message: Beyond development, he helped think through the product flow. That made a difference in simplifying screens, reducing user doubts, and making the solution feel more complete.

step1.title: Understand
step1.description: I listen to the context and map goals, users, and constraints to separate what matters now from what can wait.

step2.title: Plan
step2.description: I organize scope, screens, integrations, data, and technical risks to create a clear execution path before writing code.

step3.title: Build
step3.description: I build the solution with reusable components, clean code, API integration, and attention to the experience in every screen.

step4.title: Deliver
step4.description: I validate flows, adjust responsiveness, review interface details, and prepare the application for release or review.

step5.title: Evolve
step5.description: I follow improvements, analyze feedback, and turn new needs into continuous product refinements.
